gt table options that match glass chrome

Source: R/glass-plots.R
gt_theme_glass.Rd

Transparent table chrome so glass cards show through. Requires gt.

Usage

gt_theme_glass(
  data,
  preset = NULL,
  input = NULL,
  surface = c("clear", "opaque")
)

Arguments

data

A gt::gt() table (or data frame, which is passed to gt()).

preset, input, surface

See glass_plot_colors().

Value

A gt table.

See also

dt_options_glass(), glass_plot_colors()

Other glass plots: dt_options_glass(), glass_plot_colors(), plotly_glass(), theme_glass()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gt_theme_glass(head(mtcars), preset = "light")
}
